title: 第19章 清算到底第20章 直接摇老妈
slug: 反派神子开局送主角九族消消乐
content_zh:
【叮！
天命主角林宏炎彻底崩溃，语无伦次，不知如何是好，气运值减少400点！
【恭喜主人反派值+400！
狠！
太狠了！
众人纷纷倒吸一口凉气。
多好的美人啊！
丝毫没有怜香惜玉，直接打飞！
时间慢慢流逝，林宏炎整整被暴打了半个时辰！
若是寻常的修士，早就被打死了。
但天命主角岂能被活活打死？
不得有个皮糙肉厚的设定？
最终，林宏炎被打得彻底动弹不得，全身骨头碎裂，顶多眨眨眼皮，连惨叫声都发不出来了。
眼神中充满了深深的恐惧，以及无法掩饰的滔天恨意。
姜夜这才伸了伸懒腰，转了转僵硬的脖子，笑嘻嘻地说道：
“哎呀，不小心打太久了，应该没死吧？林兄你可别怪我呀！
谁叫你刚才打断我跟族老说话的？”
“你一个外人，胡乱插嘴可不是好习惯！”
“我帮你爹娘教育你一下，你总得感谢我吧？”
但是林宏炎完全无力回应他。

眼中带着无尽的怨恨。
姜夜甩了甩胳膊，又淡淡看向地上林宏炎，笑着道：“没关系，等你能说话了以后，再感谢我！”
众人面面相觑，脸上不禁微微抽搐。
都被打成这样了，还要感谢他？
不知道该说啥好了。
姜夜沉默了片刻，随后笑嘻嘻地着看向众人。
他甩了甩棒球棍上的血迹，横起棒头指向众人，眼中带着一丝危险的意味，问道：
“你们觉得呢？”
一时之间，场面一片寂静。
很快，虞衡第一个反应过来。
他面带笑意，仿佛如沐春风一般，抱拳开口笑道：
“哈哈哈！
真是百闻不如一见，神子殿下今日的表现，当真是给我等上了一课，让我们见识到了什么叫做少年英才！
英俊神勇！
无可匹敌！
实在是令人印象深刻，佩服万分呐！”
见此，众人纷纷附和，脸上带着谄媚之色。
“没错！
没错！
神子殿下英明神武，实乃我辈修士之楷模啊！”
content_en:
【bite!
The protagonist of Destiny, Lin Hongyan, completely collapsed. He was incoherent and didn't know what to do. His luck value was reduced by 400 points!
[Congratulations to the master for your villain value +400!
ruthless!
Too cruel!
Everyone gasped.
What a beauty!
There was no mercy at all, and he was directly beaten away!
Time passed slowly, and Lin Hongyan was beaten for half an hour!
If he were an ordinary monk, he would have been beaten to death long ago.
But how can the protagonist of Destiny be beaten to death?
Isn’t it necessary to have a thick-skinned setting?
In the end, Lin Hongyan was beaten to the point where he was completely unable to move, his bones all over his body were shattered, and he could only blink and couldn't even scream.
His eyes were filled with deep fear and overwhelming hatred that could not be concealed.
Jiang Ye then stretched, turned his stiff neck, and said with a smile:
"Oops, I accidentally beat you for too long, you shouldn't be dead, right? Brother Lin, don't blame me!
Who told you to interrupt my conversation with the clan elder just now? "
"As an outsider, it's not a good habit for you to interrupt randomly!"
"I'll help your parents educate you. You have to thank me, right?"
But Lin Hongyan was completely unable to respond to him.
There was endless resentment in his eyes.
Jiang Ye shook his arm, looked at Lin Hongyan on the ground, and said with a smile: "It doesn't matter, thank me again after you can speak!"
Everyone looked at each other, their faces twitching slightly.
After being beaten like this, you still need to thank him?
I don't know what to say.
Jiang Ye was silent for a moment, then looked at everyone with a smile.
He shook off the blood on the baseball bat, raised the bat head and pointed it at everyone, with a hint of danger in his eyes, and asked:
"What do you think?"
For a moment, the scene was silent.
Soon, Yu Heng was the first to react.
He had a smile on his face, as if he was taking a breath of spring breeze, he cupped his fists and said with a smile:
"Hahaha!
Seeing is better than hearing a hundred times. The performance of His Highness the Son of God today really taught me a lesson and allowed us to see what it means to be a young talent!
Handsome and brave!
Unrivaled!
It’s really impressive and I admire you so much! "
Seeing this, everyone agreed, with flattering looks on their faces.
"That's right!
That's right!
His Royal Highness, the Son of God, is wise and mighty, and is truly a role model for our generation of monks! "
